artists.biography:
DOMi & JD BECK are a jazz fusion duo made up of French keyboardist Domi Louna and American drummer JD Beck, who first connected in 2018 and quickly became known for their virtuosic interplay and playful, internet-savvy presentation. Domi studied at conservatories in France before attending Berklee College of Music, while Beck began playing drums at a young age in Dallas and developed his style through years of live performance and session work.

Their music blends jazz fusion with instrumental hip hop, funk, drum and bass, and rapid-fire improvisation, marked by intricate harmonies, unusual time signatures, and tightly synchronized keyboard-and-drum संवाद. Their breakout came through viral performances and collaborations with artists such as Thundercat, Anderson .Paak, Herbie Hancock, and Ariana Grande, which helped establish them as one of the most talked-about young acts in contemporary jazz.

In 2022, the duo released their debut single “Smile” and their first album, Not Tight, on Blue Note/Apeshit, earning Grammy nominations for Best New Artist and Best Contemporary Instrumental Album. Since then, DOMi & JD BECK have been widely recognized for bringing a modern, genre-blurring energy to jazz fusion while keeping the duo format central to their sound and identity.

apple_music.editorial_notes: DOMi & JD BECK are known for their dazzling, obsessively manicured mix of jazz, R&B, soft pop and electronic music—’70s fusion for the TikTok generation. Less guest-heavy but more focused than 2022’s breakout NOT TiGHT, WHO ASKED? is a jewel box of twisty hooks, hairpin rhythmic turns and layered vocal harmonies, somehow both smooth and hyper-intricate at the same time. Tracks like “PHANTOM THREAD” and “PUZZLE PiECES” show how effective they are when they streamline some of their busyness, while “CONCERTiNO (FOR PiANO, DRUMS & ORCHESTRA)” is a playful exercise in cramming as many ideas into a small, suitelike space as possible. Plenty of listeners might know them through collaborations with neo-fusion artists like Thundercat or Anderson .Paak, but there’s also more than a touch of mid-’60s Beach Boys wonder here, too.

perplexity.description:
Who Asked? is the second studio album by DOMi & JD BECK, released in 2026 on Blue Note in partnership with Anderson .Paak’s APESHIT label. It follows their breakthrough debut Not Tight and presents the duo’s signature blend of jazz, pop, R&B, and electronic textures in a more focused, more intimate setting, while still preserving the quicksilver interplay between Domi Louna’s keyboards and JD Beck’s drums.

Across its 16 tracks, the album leans into intricate hooks, layered vocal harmonies, and sharply angled rhythmic turns, balancing polished melodic writing with the duo’s trademark playful complexity. Critics and coverage described it as a more expansive but also more streamlined follow-up, one that reaches toward soft-pop brightness, jazz fusion, and even a touch of mid-’60s Beach Boys-style warmth without losing the duo’s eccentric, high-precision identity.
